sloka: पक्षी च शाखानिलयः प्रहृष्टः पुनः पुनश्चोत्तमसान्त्ववादी ।सुस्वागतां वाचमुदीरयानः पुनः पुनश्चोदयतीव हृष्टः ।। ५.२७.५१।।
transliteration: pakṣī ca śākhānilayaḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ punaḥ punaścottamasāntvavādī ।susvāgatāṁ vācamudīrayānaḥ punaḥ punaścodayatīva hṛṣṭaḥ ।। 5.27.51।।

translations.english: "One can see the bird which utters excellent sweet notes indicating happy tidings, entering again and again the foliage of the tree, a delightful bird, as if prompting Sita again and again to rejoice. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे सप्तविंशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the twentyseventh sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
